claims.text: [Observation] RF CLI `resume` and `status` are implemented in code with persistence and live gate on CLI path when `--live` or meta.live.
[Observation] Portfolio docs (build-roadmap Future table, architecture-overview, deep-dive) still claim CLI resume NOT_IMPLEMENTED.
[Inference] Doc false negatives on resume mislead operators and violate build-roadmap 'code wins' policy until REC-DOCS-RF-RESUME-TRUTH (or equivalent) lands.
[Observation] Dashboard RF adapter resume soft-accepts missing persisted state (accepted=True + hint) and does not call CLI live decision gate.
[Inference] Live/resume policy parity gap remains open per security checklist L47 and adapter vs CLI asymmetry.
[Observation] Agents sidebar legibility issue plausibly driven by global `button { white-space: nowrap }` on `.agent-card` within 280px column plus inline status concatenation.
[Inference] First GUI fix should reset whitespace/wrap on agent cards before wider layout options (Alternatives A–E); aligns with practitioner effort band and low server-side risk.
[Observation] LIVE_PROVIDERS is duplicated between daily_coder registry and dashboard adapter with manual sync comment; sets currently match by name.
[Inference] Drift risk is latent until registry changes without dashboard update; CI equality or import is preferred cheap guard.
[Observation] Daily Coder managed serve passes API token via argv; AGENT_DASHBOARD_TOKEN in root .env.example is not wired to dashboard serve entry in integrator read.
[Inference] Token delivery should move toward env/file for Daily Coder serve while weighing OWASP file/manager preference vs 12-factor env for local dev.
[Observation] Root monorepo CI does not run ruff/mypy; research-forge package CI does.
[Inference] Optional root job mirroring RF quality steps is low-cost NEXT; strict vs continue-on-error is policy choice per official lane.
[Observation] REC-04 docker sandbox and REC-06 dashboard resume lack automated tests in integrator search; REC-02 checklist has open GitHub-related rows vs shipped GH features.
[Inference] NOW band items REC-02, REC-04, REC-06 should be verified PARTIAL in roadmap truth table until tests/checklist alignment complete.
[Inference] WCAG-aligned UI should provide full text via wrap, title+aria, or disclosure—not title-only ellipsis for description/status.
[Inference] Cockburn legible-elision literature weakly supports disclosure/wrap for RQ3 only; N/A to token/CI/resume gates.
[Observation] Daily Coder live path uses dashboard UI confirm; adapter does not invoke same CLI preflight as daily-coder CLI for all gates (targeted gap lane).
